text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen said she was feeling
unwell
during training, so I've brought
her to the
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It seems I was a little fatigued. I'm sorry
to have
worried you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But thanks to you, my mood has also
rebounded.
Now, shall we resume
training?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But thanks to you, my mood has also
rebounded.
Now, shall we resume
training?
choice_data_list: 完治するまでトレーニングは禁止
ダメだ、メニューから考え直そう！
choice_data_list_en: No training until you are completely healed.
No good, let's rethink the routine from scratch!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You forbid it?! But I understand
thoroughly how
to cope with my
weakened condition.
choice_data_list: 完治するまでトレーニングは禁止
ダメだよ、メニューから考え直そう！
choice_data_list_en: No training until you are completely healed.
No way, let's rethink your routine from scratch!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: With a little rest, I'll surely—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Well, you're being unusually
strict today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fine, then. Unfortunate as it may be, I'll
do as you
say and rest for the moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Stubborn ox...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to have Mejiro McQueen focus
on resting
for the remainder of the day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What?! But you went through so much
trouble to
put it together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can judge for myself whether I've
reached my
limits or not. This small
setback is no proble—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ugh!
choice_data_list: 倒れてからでは遅いよ
choice_data_list_en: It'll be too late once you collapse.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I've inconvenienced you with my poor

self-management... I'm truly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen's injury is taking a long
time to
heal. Maybe her mental state has
had an impact
on her recovery.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I understand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This is all the result of my own
inadequacies. This
time, I will graciously
accept my lot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, I wish for my next training
regimen to
be stricter than this one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I will get better as soon as possible, and
next
time, I will complete your tests
without fail!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen gets better in no time,
just as
she declared she would. Starting
the following
day, she's in superb form.
